newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to build benzene extraction unit.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to build benzene extraction unit.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd, a leading Japanese refiner, said on Tuesday it would start construction of a 10,000 barrel-per-day benzene extraction unit at its Negishi refinery in Yokohama.
Nippon Oil plans to have the unit completed by the end of fiscal 1997/98, a company spokesman said. The fiscal year ends March 31.
The new unit will lower the amount of benzene, a cancer-causing chemical, in gasoline to below one percent, he said.
Japan's Trade Ministry earlier this year decided to toughen restrictions on the benzene content of gasoline.
Oil firms need to modify refineries to keep the benzene content under one percent by the end of 1999. The current ceiling is five percent.
